title: All Levels Soda Firing
source_quote: All Levels Soda Firing. Soda firing is an atmospheric process that creates unique and unpredictable effects as soda ash vapors react with the clay and glaze at high temperatures. This class will cover the materials and techniques required to prepare for a soda firing. The kiln will be shared equally among participants, and students will also have the option to fire their work in gas reduction
evidence_sentence: The ceramics page offers an all-levels soda firing class where participants learn to prepare work and the kiln is shared equally, with option to also fire in gas reduction.
evidence_quote: All Levels Soda Firing. Soda firing is an atmospheric process that creates unique and unpredictable effects as soda ash vapors react with the clay and glaze at high temperatures.
summary: An ongoing class for beginners and up learning soda firing techniques and preparation. The kiln is shared equally among participants, who can also fire work in gas reduction.
pay_text: Materials and studio fee included; soda firing fees $0.12 per cubic inch for enrolled members.
how_to_join: Register through the 2026 ceramics class registration system.
